title: Inspect library lookup and encoded names
description: You can separate platform observations, C API calls, and a simplified name-mangling function.

steps.description: find_library requests names for the math and C libraries. The supplied platform reports libm.so.6 and libc.so.6.
The conditional section attempts symbol inspection and handles unavailable inspection. Its message is not a call to printf.
The snippet declares ctypes result and argument types for PyList_New, then obtains an empty list. A separate C API call supplies the version text.

steps.question: Which codes does the simplified mangler append for int and double?
steps.answer: It appends i and d, forming id for that parameter list.

steps.description: The final loop prints simulated encoded names for three examples. These strings come from the Python formatting function, not from inspecting a compiled C++ binary.
